text_en: Under the National Civil Code, 2074 (2017), a marriage is valid only if both parties have given free consent, both have attained the legal marriageable age (20 years), neither is already married to another living spouse (except where polygamy has been separately permitted by law), and the parties are not within a prohibited degree of relationship. A marriage performed without free consent, or induced by fraud, coercion, or undue influence, may be declared voidable.
text_ne: मुलुकी देवानी संहिता, २०७४ अनुसार विवाह मान्य हुनको लागि दुवै पक्षको स्वतन्त्र मञ्जुरी हुनुपर्छ, दुवैको उमेर विवाह योग्य (२० वर्ष) पुगेको हुनुपर्छ, कुनै पनि पक्ष अर्को जीवित जीवनसाथीसँग विवाहित हुनु हुँदैन (कानूनले अलग्गै बहुविवाहको अनुमति दिएको अवस्था बाहेक), र पक्षहरू निषेधित नातासम्बन्धभित्र पर्नु हुँदैन। जबरजस्ती, धोका वा दबाबमा गरिएको विवाह अमान्य घोषित हुन सक्छ।
source_en: National Civil Code, 2074 (2017) — Part 2, Chapter on Marriage
source_ne: मुलुकी देवानी संहिता, २०७४ — भाग २, विवाह सम्बन्धी परिच्छेद

text_en: Either spouse may seek divorce on grounds such as cruelty, desertion for a continuous period, the other spouse's serious mental or physical incapacity, or mutual consent of both spouses. A woman may also seek divorce if her husband takes a second wife without her consent, subject to statutory exceptions. Divorce cases are filed at the District Court having jurisdiction over the couple's residence, and the court may attempt reconciliation before granting the divorce.
text_ne: क्रूरता, निरन्तर परित्याग, अर्को जीवनसाथीको गम्भीर मानसिक वा शारीरिक अक्षमता, वा दुवैको आपसी सहमतिको आधारमा जुनसुकै जीवनसाथीले सम्बन्धविच्छेदको मागदावी गर्न सक्छन्। पतिले पत्नीको सहमति बिना अर्को विवाह गरेमा कानुनी अपवादको अधीनमा रही पत्नीले पनि सम्बन्धविच्छेद माग गर्न सक्छिन्। सम्बन्धविच्छेदको मुद्दा दम्पतीको बसोबास रहेको जिल्ला अदालतमा दायर गरिन्छ र अदालतले सम्बन्धविच्छेद स्वीकृत गर्नु अघि मेलमिलापको प्रयास गर्न सक्छ।
source_en: National Civil Code, 2074 (2017) — Part 2, Chapter on Marriage and Divorce
source_ne: मुलुकी देवानी संहिता, २०७४ — भाग २, विवाह र सम्बन्धविच्छेद परिच्छेद

title_en: Equal Inheritance Rights of Daughters and Sons
title_ne: छोरी र छोराको समान अंश (उत्तराधिकार) अधिकार
text_en: The National Civil Code, 2074 (2017) recognizes daughters as coparceners with equal rights to ancestral property alongside sons, removing earlier discriminatory provisions that conditioned a daughter's share on her marital status or age. A married daughter also retains her right to parental property, subject to procedures set out in the Code for partition (bandavat).
text_ne: मुलुकी देवानी संहिता, २०७४ ले छोरीलाई छोरा सरह पैतृक सम्पत्तिमा समान अंशियारको हैसियत दिएको छ, जसले विवाह वा उमेरको आधारमा छोरीको अंशलाई सीमित गर्ने पुरानो विभेदकारी व्यवस्थालाई हटाएको छ। विवाहित छोरीले पनि संहितामा तोकिएको अंशबण्डाको प्रक्रिया अनुसार आमाबाबुको सम्पत्तिमा आफ्नो हक कायम राख्न सक्छिन्।
source_en: National Civil Code, 2074 (2017) — Part 3, Chapter on Partition of Property
source_ne: मुलुकी देवानी संहिता, २०७४ — भाग ३, अंशबण्डा सम्बन्धी परिच्छेद

title_en: Essential Elements of a Valid Contract
text_en: A contract is valid under the National Civil Code, 2074 (2017) when it is made between competent parties with free consent, for a lawful object and lawful consideration. A contract made by a minor, a person of unsound mind, or under coercion, undue influence, fraud, or misrepresentation is voidable at the option of the aggrieved party. Contracts that are against public policy or expressly forbidden by law are void.
text_ne: मुलुकी देवानी संहिता, २०७४ अनुसार सक्षम पक्षहरूबीच स्वतन्त्र मञ्जुरीमा, वैध उद्देश्य र वैध प्रतिफलका साथ भएको सम्झौता मान्य हुन्छ। नाबालक, मानसिक रूपले अस्वस्थ व्यक्ति, वा जबरजस्ती, अनुचित प्रभाव, धोका वा गलत प्रस्तुतिकरणमा भएको सम्झौता पीडित पक्षको इच्छामा अमान्य ठहर्न सक्छ। सार्वजनिक नीतिको विपरीत वा कानुनले स्पष्ट निषेध गरेको सम्झौता वदर हुन्छ।
source_en: National Civil Code, 2074 (2017) — Part 4, Chapter on Contracts
source_ne: मुलुकी देवानी संहिता, २०७४ — भाग ४, सम्झौता सम्बन्धी परिच्छेद

text_en: When a party breaches a contract, the aggrieved party may claim compensation for the loss actually suffered as a natural consequence of the breach, seek specific performance where monetary compensation would be inadequate, or rescind the contract and claim restitution of any benefit conferred. Claims for compensation must generally be filed within the limitation period prescribed by law, and the claimant must show that reasonable steps were taken to mitigate the loss.
text_ne: कुनै पक्षले सम्झौता भङ्ग गरेमा पीडित पक्षले भङ्गको स्वाभाविक परिणामस्वरूप भएको वास्तविक हानिको क्षतिपूर्ति दाबी गर्न सक्छ, पैसाले मात्र पर्याप्त उपचार नहुने अवस्थामा सम्झौता पूर्ण रूपमा कार्यान्वयन गराउन (specific performance) माग गर्न सक्छ, वा सम्झौता खारेज गरी दिइएको लाभ फिर्ता माग गर्न सक्छ। क्षतिपूर्तिको दाबी सामान्यतया कानुनले तोकेको हदम्याद भित्रै दायर गर्नुपर्छ र दाबीकर्ताले हानि घटाउन उचित प्रयास गरेको देखाउनुपर्छ।
source_en: National Civil Code, 2074 (2017) — Part 4, Chapter on Contracts, Compensation for Breach
source_ne: मुलुकी देवानी संहिता, २०७४ — भाग ४, सम्झौता भङ्ग क्षतिपूर्ति सम्बन्धी व्यवस्था

text_en: A person who causes loss or injury to another through a negligent or wrongful act is liable to pay compensation proportionate to the harm caused, under the general liability (badafi) provisions of the National Civil Code, 2074. This covers situations such as injury from a dangerous activity, damage caused by an animal under one's control, or harm resulting from failure to exercise reasonable care, and applies whether or not there is a pre-existing contract between the parties.
text_ne: मुलुकी देवानी संहिताको सामान्य दायित्व (बदफैली) सम्बन्धी व्यवस्था अनुसार लापरबाही वा गलत कार्यबाट अर्कोलाई हानि वा चोट पुर्‍याउने व्यक्ति भएको हानिको अनुपातमा क्षतिपूर्ति तिर्न उत्तरदायी हुन्छ। यसले खतरनाक गतिविधिबाट भएको चोट, आफ्नो नियन्त्रणमा रहेको जनावरबाट भएको क्षति, वा उचित सावधानी नअपनाएकोले भएको हानि जस्ता अवस्थाहरूलाई समेट्छ, र पक्षहरूबीच पहिलेदेखि सम्झौता भए वा नभए पनि यो लागू हुन्छ।
source_en: National Civil Code, 2074 (2017) — Part 5, Chapter on Liability (Badafi)
source_ne: मुलुकी देवानी संहिता, २०७४ — भाग ५, बदफैली (दायित्व) सम्बन्धी परिच्छेद

title_en: Rights and Duties in a Lease (Rent) Agreement
text_en: In a lease of house or land, the lessor must hand over peaceful possession of the property and the lessee must pay the agreed rent and use the property as agreed. Either party may terminate the lease by giving the notice period specified in the agreement or, if none is specified, a reasonable notice as recognized by practice and law. A lessee cannot be evicted arbitrarily without following the process for termination and, where applicable, court process.
text_ne: घर वा जग्गाको भाडा सम्झौतामा घरधनीले सम्पत्तिको शान्तिपूर्ण भोगचलन दिनुपर्छ र भाडावालले सहमति भएको भाडा तिर्नुपर्छ र सम्पत्तिलाई सहमति अनुसार प्रयोग गर्नुपर्छ। कुनै पनि पक्षले सम्झौतामा तोकिएको सूचना अवधि दिई, वा नतोकिएमा प्रचलन र कानुनले मान्यता दिएको उचित सूचना दिई सम्झौता अन्त्य गर्न सक्छ। भाडावालालाई अन्त्यको प्रक्रिया र आवश्यक परेमा अदालती प्रक्रिया नपुर्‍याई स्वेच्छाचारी रूपमा घर खाली गर्न लगाउन मिल्दैन।
source_en: National Civil Code, 2074 (2017) — Part 3, Chapter on Contract of Lease
source_ne: मुलुकी देवानी संहिता, २०७४ — भाग ३, भाडा सम्झौता सम्बन्धी परिच्छेद

text_en: Adoption under the National Civil Code, 2074 (2017) requires the free consent of the person being adopted if they are of an age to understand the matter, and where a married couple adopts, the consent of both spouses. An adopted child acquires the same rights, including inheritance rights, in the adoptive family as a biological child, while the specific procedure and approvals required depend on whether the adoption is domestic or intercountry.
text_ne: मुलुकी देवानी संहिता, २०७४ अनुसार गोद लिने प्रक्रियामा गोद लिइने व्यक्ति कुरा बुझ्ने उमेरको भएमा निजको स्वतन्त्र मञ्जुरी आवश्यक हुन्छ, र विवाहित दम्पतीले गोद लिँदा दुवै पति-पत्नीको मञ्जुरी चाहिन्छ। गोद लिइएको बालबालिकाले गोद लिने परिवारमा अंश हकसहित जैविक सन्तान सरह अधिकार पाउँछ, जबकि आवश्यक प्रक्रिया र स्वीकृति गोद लिने कार्य स्वदेशी हो कि अन्तर्देशीय हो भन्नेमा भर पर्छ।
source_en: National Civil Code, 2074 (2017) — Part 2, Chapter on Adoption
source_ne: मुलुकी देवानी संहिता, २०७४ — भाग २, धर्मपुत्र/धर्मपुत्री सम्बन्धी परिच्छेद

text_en: A minor's parents are ordinarily the natural guardians responsible for the minor's person and property. If both parents are unable to act as guardian, the court may appoint a guardian giving priority to the minor's best interest, and a guardian appointed by the court must manage the minor's property with reasonable care and render account when required, and may not dispose of the minor's immovable property without the court's permission.
text_ne: सामान्यतया नाबालकका आमाबाबु नै निजको शरीर र सम्पत्तिको प्राकृतिक संरक्षक हुन्छन्। दुवै आमाबाबु संरक्षकको जिम्मेवारी वहन गर्न असमर्थ भएमा अदालतले नाबालकको सर्वोत्तम हितलाई प्राथमिकता दिई संरक्षक तोक्न सक्छ, र अदालतले तोकेको संरक्षकले नाबालकको सम्पत्ति उचित सावधानीपूर्वक व्यवस्थापन गर्नुपर्छ, आवश्यक परेमा लेखा पेश गर्नुपर्छ, र अदालतको अनुमति बिना नाबालकको अचल सम्पत्ति बिक्री गर्न पाउँदैन।
source_en: National Civil Code, 2074 (2017) — Part 2, Chapter on Guardianship
source_ne: मुलुकी देवानी संहिता, २०७४ — भाग २, संरक्षकत्व सम्बन्धी परिच्छेद

text_en: A person who injures another's reputation by making or publishing a false statement, without lawful justification, may be held liable to pay compensation under the civil liability provisions of the National Civil Code, 2074 (2017), separate from any criminal liability for defamation under the National Penal (Criminal) Code. The claimant must generally show that the statement was false, was communicated to a third party, and caused harm to reputation.
text_ne: कानुनी औचित्य बिना झुटो भनाइ गरेर वा प्रकाशित गरेर अर्काको प्रतिष्ठामा हानि पुर्‍याउने व्यक्तिलाई मुलुकी देवानी संहिता, २०७४ को देवानी दायित्व सम्बन्धी व्यवस्था अनुसार क्षतिपूर्ति तिर्न लगाउन सकिन्छ, जुन मुलुकी अपराध संहिता अन्तर्गतको मानहानिको फौजदारी दायित्वभन्दा फरक हो। दाबीकर्ताले सामान्यतया भनाइ झुटो थियो, तेस्रो पक्षलाई सुनाइयो वा प्रकाशित गरियो, र त्यसले प्रतिष्ठामा हानि पुर्‍यायो भन्ने देखाउनुपर्छ।
source_en: National Civil Code, 2074 (2017) — Part 5, Chapter on Liability (Badafi)
source_ne: मुलुकी देवानी संहिता, २०७४ — भाग ५, बदफैली सम्बन्धी परिच्छेद

text_en: Civil claims under the National Civil Code, 2074 (2017) must ordinarily be filed within the limitation period fixed for that particular type of claim, commonly two years from the date the cause of action arises unless a different period is specified for a particular claim, such as claims relating to partition of property or a contract, and a claim filed after the limitation period may be dismissed even if otherwise valid, subject to limited exceptions.
text_ne: मुलुकी देवानी संहिता, २०७४ अन्तर्गतका देवानी दाबीहरू सामान्यतया सम्बन्धित दाबीको लागि तोकिएको हदम्याद भित्रै दायर गर्नुपर्छ, जुन प्रायः दाबीको कारण उत्पन्न भएको मितिले दुई वर्ष हुन्छ, जबसम्म अंशबण्डा वा सम्झौता जस्ता विशेष दाबीको लागि फरक अवधि तोकिएको छैन। सीमित अपवाद बाहेक हदम्याद नाघेपछि दायर गरिएको दाबी अन्यथा मान्य भए तापनि खारेज हुन सक्छ।
source_en: National Civil Code, 2074 (2017) — Part 1, Chapter on Limitation
source_ne: मुलुकी देवानी संहिता, २०७४ — भाग १, हदम्याद सम्बन्धी परिच्छेद

title_en: Landmark Case: Equal Property Rights for Daughters
title_ne: ऐतिहासिक फैसला: छोरीको समान अंश अधिकार
text_en: In a series of public interest litigations led by women's rights advocates (including Advocate Meera Dhungana) in the early 2000s, the Supreme Court of Nepal directed the government to amend discriminatory inheritance laws that denied unmarried daughters an equal share of parental property or stripped a daughter's share upon marriage. These rulings were a major driver behind the reform later consolidated in the National Civil Code, 2074 (2017), which grants sons and daughters equal coparcenary rights.
text_ne: सन् २००० को दशकको सुरुतिर महिला अधिकारवादी अधिवक्ताहरू (अधिवक्ता मीरा ढुंगानासहित) ले दायर गरेका जनहित मुद्दाहरूमा नेपालको सर्वोच्च अदालतले अविवाहित छोरीलाई आमाबाबुको सम्पत्तिमा समान अंश नदिने वा विवाहपछि छोरीको अंश खोसिने विभेदकारी कानुनमा संशोधन गर्न सरकारलाई निर्देशन दिएको थियो। यी फैसलाहरूले पछि मुलुकी देवानी संहिता, २०७४ मा समेटिएको सुधारलाई ठूलो प्रोत्साहन दिए, जसले छोरा र छोरीलाई समान अंशियार अधिकार दिन्छ।

title_en: Landmark Case: Recognition of Marital Rape as a Crime
title_ne: ऐतिहासिक फैसला: वैवाहिक बलात्कारलाई अपराधको रूपमा मान्यता
text_en: Public interest litigation filed by women's rights advocates led the Supreme Court of Nepal to direct the government to criminalize marital rape, rejecting the earlier legal position that a husband could not be held criminally liable for non-consensual sex with his wife. This judicial recognition contributed to the subsequent statutory criminalization of marital rape under Nepal's Penal Code framework, alongside related civil remedies for the survivor including compensation.
text_ne: महिला अधिकारवादी अधिवक्ताहरूले दायर गरेको जनहित मुद्दामा सर्वोच्च अदालतले पतिले पत्नीको मञ्जुरी बिना यौन सम्पर्क राखेमा फौजदारी दायित्व नहुने पुरानो कानुनी अवस्थालाई अस्वीकार गर्दै वैवाहिक बलात्कारलाई अपराधीकरण गर्न सरकारलाई निर्देशन दियो। यस न्यायिक मान्यताले पछि मुलुकी अपराध संहिता अन्तर्गत वैवाहिक बलात्कारको अपराधीकरणमा योगदान पुर्‍यायो, साथै पीडितका लागि क्षतिपूर्तिसहितका देवानी उपचारहरू पनि सम्भव बनायो।

title_en: Landmark Case: Gender Equality in Citizenship Transmission
text_en: Advocate Sapana Pradhan-Malla and other petitioners challenged provisions that made it harder for a Nepali mother, as opposed to a Nepali father, to pass citizenship to her child, particularly where the father was unknown, absent, or foreign. The Supreme Court's rulings in this line of cases pushed for a more gender-equal reading of citizenship provisions, though full legislative parity has remained a continuing area of legal and political debate.
text_ne: अधिवक्ता सपना प्रधान मल्ल र अन्य निवेदकहरूले नेपाली आमाले, नेपाली बुबाको तुलनामा, विशेष गरी बुबा अज्ञात, अनुपस्थित वा विदेशी भएको अवस्थामा आफ्नो सन्तानलाई नागरिकता हस्तान्तरण गर्न गाह्रो बनाउने व्यवस्थाहरूलाई चुनौती दिएका थिए। यस श्रृंखलाका मुद्दाहरूमा सर्वोच्च अदालतका फैसलाहरूले नागरिकता व्यवस्थालाई थप लैंगिक समानतापूर्ण ढंगले व्याख्या गर्न जोड दिए, यद्यपि पूर्ण कानुनी समानता अझै निरन्तर कानुनी र राजनीतिक बहसको विषय रहेको छ।

text_en: Where a contract is entered into on standard, non-negotiable terms drafted by the stronger party (such as a service provider), and a term is found to be unreasonable, unconscionable, or contrary to public policy, courts may refuse to enforce that specific term even while upholding the rest of the contract. Consumers also have remedies under Nepal's consumer protection legislation for defective goods, false advertising, or unfair trade practices, which may be pursued alongside or instead of a civil claim for breach of contract.

text_en: We, the Sovereign People of Nepal, cherishing the noble tradition of historic people's movements, armed struggles, sacrifices and martyrdom for the sake of national interest, democracy and progressive change, and honoring the martyrs and the disappeared and victimized citizens; ending all forms of discrimination and oppression created by the feudal, autocratic, centralized and unitary state system; embracing the multi-ethnic, multi-lingual, multi-religious, multi-cultural and geographically diverse characteristics of Nepal, and protecting and promoting unity in diversity, social and cultural solidarity, tolerance and harmony; resolving to build an egalitarian society based on the principles of proportional inclusion and participation to ensure economic equality, prosperity and social justice by ending class, ethnic, regional, linguistic, religious, gender-based discrimination and all forms of untouchability; being committed to building a prosperous nation by remaining committed to the democratic values and norms including the competitive multi-party democratic governance system, civil liberties, fundamental rights, human rights, child rights, periodic elections, full press freedom, and an independent, impartial and competent judiciary and the concept of the rule of law; and by fulfilling the aspiration of sustainable peace, good governance, development and prosperity through the federal democratic republican governance system, do hereby pass and issue this Constitution through the Constituent Assembly.
text_ne: हामी सार्वभौमसत्तासम्पन्न नेपाली जनता; नेपालको स्वतन्त्रता, सार्वभौमिकता, भौगोलिक अखण्डता, राष्ट्रिय एकता, स्वाधीनता र स्वाभिमानलाई अक्षुण्ण राखी जनताको सार्वभौम अधिकार, स्वायत्तता र स्वशासनको अधिकारलाई आत्मसात् गर्दै; राष्ट्रहित, लोकतन्त्र र अग्रगामी परिवर्तनका लागि नेपाली जनताले पटक–पटक गर्दै आएका ऐतिहासिक जन आन्दोलन, सशस्त्र संघर्ष, त्याग र बलिदानको गौरवपूर्ण इतिहासलाई स्मरण एवं शहीदहरू तथा बेपत्ता र पीडित नागरिकहरूलाई सम्मान गर्दै; सामन्ती, निरंकुश, केन्द्रीकृत र एकात्मक राज्यव्यवस्थाले सृजना गरेका सबै प्रकारका विभेद र उत्पीडनको अन्त्य गर्दै; बहुजातीय, बहुभाषिक, बहुधार्मिक, बहुसांस्कृतिक तथा भौगोलिक विविधतायुक्त विशेषतालाई आत्मसात् गरी विविधताबीचको एकता, सामाजिक सांस्कृतिक ऐक्यबद्धता, सहिष्णुता र सद्भावलाई संरक्षण एवं प्रवर्धन गर्दै; वर्गीय, जातीय, क्षेत्रीय, भाषिक, धार्मिक, लैंगिक विभेद र सबै प्रकारका जातीय छुवाछूतको अन्त्य गरी आर्थिक समानता, समृद्धि र सामाजिक न्याय सुनिश्चित गर्न समानुपातिक समावेशी र सहभागितामूलक सिद्धान्तका आधारमा समतामूलक समाजको निर्माण गर्ने संकल्प गर्दै; जनताको प्रतिस्पर्धात्मक बहुदलीय लोकतान्त्रिक शासन प्रणाली, नागरिक स्वतन्त्रता, मौलिक अधिकार, मानव अधिकार, बालिग मताधिकार, आवधिक निर्वाचन, पूर्ण प्रेस स्वतन्त्रता तथा स्वतन्त्र, निष्पक्ष र सक्षम न्यायपालिका र कानूनी राज्यको अवधारणा लगायतका लोकतान्त्रिक मूल्य र मान्यतामा आधारित समाजवादप्रति प्रतिबद्ध रही समृद्ध राष्ट्र निर्माण गर्न; संघीय लोकतान्त्रिक गणतन्त्रात्मक शासन व्यवस्थाको माध्यमद्वारा दिगो शान्ति, सुशासन, विकास र समृद्धिको आकांक्षा पूरा गर्न संविधान सभाबाट पारित गरी यो संविधान जारी गर्दछौं ।

text_en: (1) This Constitution is the fundamental law of Nepal. Any law inconsistent with this Constitution shall, to the extent of such inconsistency, be void. (2) It shall be the duty of every person to uphold this Constitution.
text_ne: (१) यो संविधान नेपालको मूल कानून हो । यस संविधानसँग बाझिने कानून बाझिएको हदसम्म अमान्य हुनेछ । (२) यस संविधानको पालना गर्नु प्रत्येक व्यक्तिको कर्तव्य हुनेछ ।

text_en: The sovereignty and state authority of Nepal are vested in the Nepali people. The exercise thereof shall be in accordance with the provisions of this Constitution.
text_ne: नेपालको सार्वभौमसत्ता र राजकीयसत्ता नेपाली जनतामा निहित रहेको छ । यसको प्रयोग यस संविधानमा व्यवस्था भए बमोजिम हुनेछ ।

text_en: Having multi-ethnic, multi-lingual, multi-religious, multi-cultural characteristics with common aspirations of people living in Nepal and being committed to and united by a bond of allegiance to national independence, territorial integrity, national interest and prosperity of Nepal, all the Nepali people collectively constitute the nation.
text_ne: बहुजातीय, बहुभाषिक, बहुधार्मिक, बहुसांस्कृतिक विशेषतायुक्त, भौगोलिक विविधतामा रहेका समान आकांक्षा र नेपालको राष्ट्रिय स्वतन्त्रता, भौगोलिक अखण्डता, राष्ट्रिय हित तथा समृद्धिप्रति आस्थावान रही एकताको सूत्रमा आबद्ध सबै नेपाली जनता समष्टिमा राष्ट्र हो ।

text_en: (1) Nepal is an independent, indivisible, sovereign, secular, inclusive, democratic, socialism-oriented, federal democratic republican state. Explanation: For the purposes of this Article, "secular" means protection of religion and culture being practiced since ancient times and religious and cultural freedom. (2) The territory of Nepal shall comprise: (a) the territory existing at the commencement of this Constitution, and (b) such other territory as may be acquired after the commencement of this Constitution.
text_ne: (१) नेपाल स्वतन्त्र, अविभाज्य, सार्वभौमसत्तासम्पन्न, धर्मनिरपेक्ष, समावेशी, लोकतान्त्रिक, समाजवाद उन्मुख, संघीय लोकतान्त्रिक गणतन्त्रात्मक राज्य हो । स्पष्टीकरण: यस धाराको प्रयोजनका लागि “धर्मनिरपेक्ष” भन्नाले सनातनदेखि चलिआएको धर्म संस्कृतिको संरक्षण लगायत धार्मिक, सांस्कृतिक स्वतन्त्रता सम्झनु पर्छ । (२) नेपालको क्षेत्र देहाय बमोजिम हुनेछ:– (क) यो संविधान प्रारम्भ हुँदाका बखतको क्षेत्र, र (ख) यो संविधान प्रारम्भ भएपछि प्राप्त हुने क्षेत्र ।

text_en: (1) Safeguarding the freedom, sovereignty, territorial integrity, nationality, independence and dignity of Nepal, the rights of the Nepali people, border security, economic wellbeing and prosperity shall be the basic elements of the national interest of Nepal. (2) Any conduct and act contrary to the national interest shall be punishable by federal law.
text_ne: (१) नेपालको स्वतन्त्रता, सार्वभौमसत्ता, भौगोलिक अखण्डता, राष्ट्रियता, स्वाधीनता, स्वाभिमान, नेपालीको हक हितको रक्षा, सीमानाको सुरक्षा, आर्थिक समुन्नति र समृद्धि नेपालको राष्ट्रिय हितका आधारभूत विषय हुनेछन् । (२) राष्ट्र हित प्रतिकूलको आचरण र कार्य संघीय कानून बमोजिम दण्डनीय हुनेछ ।

text_en: All the languages spoken in Nepal are the national languages of Nepal.
text_ne: नेपालमा बोलिने सबै मातृभाषाहरू राष्ट्रभाषा हुन् ।

text_en: (1) The Nepali language written in Devanagari script shall be the official language of Nepal. (2) In addition to the Nepali language, a province may, by a provincial law, determine one or more other national languages spoken by a majority of the people in the province as its official language. (3) Other matters relating to language shall be as decided by the Government of Nepal on the recommendation of the Language Commission.
text_ne: (१) देवनागरी लिपिमा लेखिने नेपाली भाषा नेपालको सरकारी कामकाजको भाषा हुनेछ । (२) नेपाली भाषाका अतिरिक्त प्रदेशले आफ्नो प्रदेशभित्र बहुसंख्यक जनताले बोल्ने एक वा एकभन्दा बढी अन्य राष्ट्रभाषालाई प्रदेश कानून बमोजिम प्रदेशको सरकारी कामकाजको भाषा निर्धारण गर्न सक्नेछ । (३) भाषा सम्बन्धी अन्य कुरा भाषा आयोगको सिफारिसमा नेपाल सरकारले निर्णय गरे बमोजिम हुनेछ ।

text_en: (1) The national flag of Nepal consists of two juxtaposed triangular figures with crimson base and deep blue borders, there being a white emblem of the crescent moon with eight rays in the upper part and a white emblem of a twelve-rayed sun in the lower part. (2) The method of making the national flag and other details relating thereto shall be as mentioned in Schedule-1.
text_ne: (१) सिम्रिक रङ्गको भुइँ र गाढा नीलो रङ्गको किनारा भएको दुई त्रिकोण अलिकति जोडिएको, माथिल्लो भागमा खुपे चन्द्रको बीचमा सोह्रमा आठ कोण देखिने सेतो आकार र तल्लो भागमा बाह्र कोणयुक्त सूर्यको सेतो आकार अंकित भएको झण्डा नेपालको राष्ट्रिय झण्डा हो । (२) नेपालको राष्ट्रिय झण्डा, राष्ट्रिय झण्डा बनाउने तरिका र तत्सम्बन्धी अन्य विवरण अनुसूची–१ मा उल्लेख भए बमोजिम हुनेछ ।

text_en: (1) The national anthem of Nepal shall be as mentioned in Schedule-2. (2) The coat of arms of Nepal shall be as mentioned in Schedule-3. (3) The national flower of Nepal shall be Rhododendron, national color crimson, national animal cow and national bird Danphe.

title_en: Not to be deprived of citizenship
text_en: (1) No Nepali citizen shall be deprived of the right to obtain citizenship. (2) There shall be a provision of single federal citizenship with provincial identity in Nepal.
text_ne: (१) कुनै पनि नेपाली नागरिकलाई नागरिकता प्राप्त गर्ने हकबाट वञ्चित गरिने छैन । (२) नेपालमा प्रादेशिक पहिचान सहितको एकल संघीय नागरिकताको व्यवस्था गरिएको छ ।

text_en: (1) Persons who have obtained citizenship of Nepal at the time of commencement of this Constitution and who are eligible to obtain citizenship under this Part shall be citizens of Nepal. (2) The following persons who have their permanent domicile in Nepal shall be deemed to be citizens of Nepal by descent: (a) A person who has obtained citizenship of Nepal by descent before the commencement of this Constitution, (b) Any person whose father or mother was a citizen of Nepal at his or her birth. (3) Every child who is found within Nepal and the whereabouts of whose father and mother are not known shall, until the father or the mother of the child is traced, be deemed to be a citizen of Nepal by descent. (4) A person born to a Nepali citizen mother and having his or her domicile in Nepal but whose father has not been identified shall be a citizen of Nepal by descent: Provided that, in case the father is found to be a foreign citizen, the citizenship of such person shall be converted into naturalized citizenship in accordance with federal law. (5) A foreign woman who has entered into matrimonial relationship with a Nepali citizen may acquire naturalized citizenship of Nepal as provided for by a federal law. (6) Notwithstanding anything contained elsewhere in this Article, in the case of a person born to a Nepali woman citizen married to a foreign citizen, such person may acquire naturalized citizenship of Nepal in accordance with federal law if he or she has permanently resided in Nepal and has not acquired the citizenship of a foreign country. (7) The Government of Nepal may grant naturalized citizenship of Nepal as provided for by federal law. (8) The Government of Nepal may grant honorary citizenship of Nepal as provided for by federal law. (9) If any territory is acquired by Nepal by way of merger, persons residing in such territory shall be citizens of Nepal subject to federal law.

title_en: Citizenship with descent and gender identity
title_ne: वंशीय आधार तथा लैङ्गिक पहिचान सहितको नागरिकता
text_en: A person who is entitled to obtain citizenship of Nepal by descent under this Constitution may obtain a certificate of citizenship of Nepal with gender identity from the name of his or her mother or father.

title_ne: गैरआवासीय नेपाली नागरिकता प्रदान गर्न सकिने
text_en: Non-resident Nepali citizenship may be granted to a person who has acquired citizenship of a foreign country, who resides in a country other than a member nation of the South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation, and who or whose father or mother, grandfather or grandmother was a citizen of Nepal by descent or birth and later acquired the citizenship of a foreign country, allowing him or her to enjoy economic, social and cultural rights as provided for by federal law.

text_en: Other provisions relating to citizenship of Nepal shall be as provided for by federal law, including the maintenance of records of every citizen.
text_ne: नेपालको प्रत्येक नागरिकको परिचय खुल्ने गरी अभिलेख राख्ने तथा नेपालको नागरिकता सम्बन्धी अन्य व्यवस्था संघीय कानून बमोजिम हुनेछ ।

title_en: Not to be deprived of citizenship
text_en: (1) No citizen of Nepal shall be deprived of the right to obtain citizenship. (2) There shall be a provision of single federal citizenship with provincial identity in Nepal.
text_ne: (१) कुनै पनि नेपाली नागरिकलाई नागरिकता प्राप्त गर्ने हकबाट वञ्चित गरिने छैन । (२) नेपालमा प्रादेशिक पहिचान सहितको एकल संघीय नागरिकताको व्यवस्था गरिएको छ ।

text_en: (1) Persons who have obtained citizenship of Nepal at the time of the commencement of this Constitution and who are eligible to obtain citizenship in accordance with this Part shall be citizens of Nepal. (2) The following persons who have their permanent domicile in Nepal shall be deemed to be citizens of Nepal by descent: (a) A person who has obtained citizenship of Nepal by descent before the commencement of this Constitution, (b) Any person whose father or mother was a citizen of Nepal at the birth of such person. (3) Every child who is found within Nepal and the whereabouts of whose father and mother are not known shall, until the father or the mother of the child is traced, be deemed to be a citizen of Nepal by descent. (4) A person born in Nepal from a Nepali citizen mother and having resided in Nepal as his or her permanent domicile, and whose father has not been identified, shall be provided with citizenship of Nepal by descent. Provided that, in case the father is found to be a foreign citizen, the citizenship of such person shall be converted into naturalized citizenship in accordance with federal law. (5) A foreign woman who has entered into matrimonial relationship with a Nepali citizen may, if she so wishes, acquire naturalized citizenship of Nepal in accordance with federal law. (6) Notwithstanding anything contained elsewhere in this Article, in the case of a person born in Nepal from a woman who is a citizen of Nepal and has married a foreign citizen, provided such person has permanently resided in Nepal and has not acquired the citizenship of a foreign country, he or she may acquire naturalized citizenship of Nepal in accordance with federal law. (8) The Government of Nepal may, in accordance with federal law, grant honorary citizenship of Nepal. (9) In the event of any territory being acquired by Nepal, persons residing in such territory shall become citizens of Nepal subject to federal law.

text_en: A person who is entitled to obtain citizenship of Nepal by descent in accordance with this Constitution may obtain a certificate of citizenship of Nepal with gender identity in the name of his or her mother or father.

title_en: Acquisition, re-acquisition and termination of citizenship
text_en: Other provisions relating to the acquisition, re-acquisition and termination of citizenship shall be as provided for by federal law.
text_ne: नागरिकताको प्राप्ति, पुनःप्राप्ति र समाप्ति सम्बन्धी अन्य व्यवस्था संघीय कानून बमोजिम हुनेछ ।

title_en: Other provisions relating to citizenship of Nepal
text_en: Other provisions relating to the maintenance of records of every citizen of Nepal and other matters relating to citizenship shall be as provided for by federal law.
